summary: Created the local contractor account on node1 with a generated password, 60-day maximum password age, and 10-day expiration warning. Configuration persisted through the required node restart.
actions_performed: Generated and applied a password entirely on node1 without exposing it.
Set password maximum age to 60 days and warning period to 10 days.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its changed boot identity and recovered health.

evidence.requirement: Local contractor account with configured password and required aging policy
evidence.summary: Direct pre- and post-restart passwd/shadow checks show contractor is local, credential=password-set, max_days=60, warn_days=10, and its home directory is correctly owned.

Healthy baseline used boot ID be303eb3-eeb6-4466-86f1-fd6406dd7dad; systemd acknowledged the reboot; recovered node reported boot ID 2f6afb7f-3305-4b28-a282-df6ae6935f5d, running system state, active user-sessions service, and intact account data.
